[{"insert":"Seated Strict Press + Strict Bar Dip

This press and dip pairing hits your shoulders and triceps from two angles with a short rest between. The seated strict press takes your legs out of it so your shoulders do all the overhead work, and reps drop to 6 this week so you can press heavier. The strict bar dip that follows uses a slow 30X0 tempo — three seconds down — to load the bottom stretch. Keep both close to form failure.
"}]
